title: Blob
wikitext:
Legendary Finnish QuakeWorld player. Co-founder of [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Satanic Slaughter Clan]]. According to his fellow team mates, '''Blob''' "cowardly quit QW in late 2006".

== Information ==
* '''Real name:''' Bingo Larsson
* '''Date of birth:''' 1980
* '''Nationality:''' [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] Finnish
* '''Current clan:''' [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Satanic Slaughter Clan]]
